FN-2JWM6KI-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 241
Committee: Veterans, Military Affairs and Public Safety Sponsor: Senator Lance Bell
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/02/2025
Senate Bill 241 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement
Agency (ALEA), by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to develop and operate the
statewide inter-jurisdictional Alabama Criminal Enterprise Database, as provided by this bill,
subject to the availability of funding. This increase in obligations could be offset, in part,
dependent on the amount of civil penalties imposed by the Secretary of ALEA for violating
rules regarding the database, as provided by this bill.

FN-2JWM6KI-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 241
Committee: Public Safety and Homeland Security Sponsor: Senator Lance Bell
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 04/28/2025
Senate Bill 241 as passed the Senate would increase the obligations of the Alabama Law
Enforcement Agency (ALEA) by an undetermined amount dependent on the cost to develop and
operate the statewide inter-jurisdictional Alabama Criminal Enterprise Database and comply
with the annual reporting requirements as provided by this bill, subject to the availability of
funding. This increase in obligations could be offset, in part, dependent on the amount of civil
penalties imposed by the Secretary of ALEA for violating rules regarding the database, as
provided by this bill.
